2607.29459.title: TFGformer: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting via Time-Frequency Graph Learning and Covariate Fusion
2607.29459.paper_summary: Large-scale multivariate time series from heterogeneous IoT sensors demand accurate long-term forecasting for resource scheduling and predictive maintenance. While recent time series foundation models exhibit strong generalization, they rely on static parametric knowledge and lack dynamic access to external historical patterns during inference. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) offers a potential remedy, yet its application to time series forecasting is challenged by magnitude variations across heterogeneous sources and the mismatch between historical similarity and future consistency. We propose CrossRAG, a retrieval-augmented forecasting framework that integrates Shape-Aware Memory (SAM) with RevIN normalization for magnitude-robust shape-level retrieval, Future-Consistent Contrastive (FCC) learning to distinguish informative references from hard negatives with similar history but divergent futures, and Cross-Attention Temporal Fusion (CATF) to fuse retrieved historical--future reference pairs into the backbone's representations at the representation level. Experiments on seven public benchmarks show that CrossRAG consistently outperforms both parametric-only baselines and existing retrieval-augmented forecasting methods.
2607.29459.paper_summary_zh: 大型多變量時間序列來自異質物聯網傳感器，需求準確的長期預測以進行資源調度和預測性維護。雖然最近的時間序列基礎模型展現了強大的泛化能力，但它們依賴於靜態參數知識，並在推斷過程中缺乏對外部歷史模式的動態訪問。檢索增強生成（RAG）提供了一種潛在的解決方案，但其在時間序列預測中的應用受到異質來源之間的幅度變化以及歷史相似性與未來一致性之間的不匹配的挑戰。我們提出了CrossRAG，一種檢索增強的預測框架，將形狀感知記憶（SAM）與RevIN正規化相結合，以實現幅度穩健的形狀級檢索，未來一致對比（FCC）學習以區分具有相似歷史但未來不同的信息參考和困難負樣本，以及交叉注意力時間融合（CATF）將檢索到的歷史-未來參考對融合到主幹的表示中。在七個公共基準上的實驗顯示，CrossRAG始終超越了僅基於參數的基準和現有的檢索增強預測方法。
